source_bindings.jinc_boundary: SCI-JINC_TO_SCI-FLT-FIXED boundary admitted by the author packet

profiles.domain: one exact request, one complete immutable parent bundle, and one exact resolved FLT-owned plan
restrictions: exactly one supported MAP-observation, MAP-coadd, or JINC-observation parent role
complete applicable parent and boundary identity
FLT-FIXED-CONV only
same grid
one exact resolved sampled convolution
full-footprint-only
no data-derived selection or relearning
plan facts are independent of parent payload amplitudes
scientific operator identity is independent of representation identity
S_parent_fact, D_m, S_out, and S_out_zero are separately typed
every sampled coefficient is finite, real, unit-typed, canonically represented, and content-bound
decisive_exclusions: representation fact that changes scientific operator identity or behavior
missing, non-finite, complex, unrepresentable, or conflicting coefficient
exceptions: base signal may carry typed unavailable response or covariance state
qualified requests require their named available compatible companion
profiles.consumer_action: admit the exact bundle to parent-row admission, or fail closed with typed causes; perform no payload arithmetic

profiles.domain: one exact row in S_parent_fact under one eligible bundle, frozen plan, immutable parent facts, and named FLT use
restrictions: the parent row lies in exact S_parent_fact
the parent row is admitted for this named FLT use
the parent row lies in D_m because an available finite real signal payload exists
membership in D_m is established before m_q is evaluated
every parent-row predicate passes
the decision supplies exact row admission, availability, finiteness, support, and predicates for FLT construction of J_full and S_out
finite-state classification comes from declared typed row facts, is structural screening, does not evaluate m_q, and cannot tune the plan
exceptions: none; identity support and independently constructed S_out_zero belong to FLT after parent-row decisions
profiles.consumer_action: return one immutable parent-row decision with typed causes to FLT; do not construct J_full or S_out and perform no payload arithmetic

profiles.domain: one exact complete_publication_disposition_candidate with product_candidate or no_output_support_candidate variant

candidate_variants.product_candidate: complete atomic FLT product bundle with all required roles
candidate_variants.no_output_support_candidate: exact request, parent, plan, operator, K_req, attempted S_out construction, empty-domain proof, row/cause accounting, application generation, applied_no_scientific_output_support state, and prescribed cause; no realized FLT-SIG and no atomic bundle

restrictions: product_candidate contains every required FLT role
no_output_support_candidate contains every exact proof and evidence field and no realized FLT-SIG
base signal contains exact response and covariance state records, which may be unavailable
response-qualified candidate has an available exact compatible response
covariance-qualified candidate has the exact declared compatible covariance representation
jointly qualified candidate satisfies both companion qualifications
FLT-NOI-COMPATIBILITY is immutable, contains no future NOI identity, and an NOI product is not required
a publication-time not-requested NOI state is historical provenance and cannot block a later independently requested compatible child
exceptions: optional companion unavailability does not block a base signal request
identity and zero use product_candidate and the publication sequence
a requested nonzero convolution with empty S_out retains applied evidence but publishes no base signal
profiles.consumer_action: return disposition and prescribed action to the FLT publisher; the profile or VAL evaluation performs no publication, and the publisher alone realizes or declines the FLT product
